lessons.title: Learn Flutter Lists in 4 Minutes | Create, Add, Remove, Loop - Step by Step
lessons.summary: Create a list, add Orange, remove Banana, and loop through it to build the screen — in 4 minutes.
lessons.body:
A List in Dart holds many items in one variable — here, a list of fruits.

1. Create — List<String> fruits = ['Apple', 'Banana', 'Mango'];
2. Add — fruits.add('Orange'); adds one item at the end.
3. Remove — fruits.remove('Banana'); takes that item out.
4. Loop — a for loop goes through every fruit and makes one ListTile for it, so the screen shows the whole list.

Because the list changes inside setState, Flutter rebuilds the screen and you see the new list right away. Download lists_example.dart, run it, press Add Orange and Remove Banana, and watch the total count change.

lessons.title: Dart List Methods in Flutter | map, where, firstWhere & sort
lessons.summary: Master essential Dart list methods like map, where, firstWhere, and sort to filter and transform data efficiently.
lessons.body:
Dart lists provide powerful built-in methods to transform, filter, and sort data with minimal code.

1. map — Transforms every item in a list into a new form and creates a new list.
2. where — Filters a list, keeping only the items that pass a true/false condition.
3. firstWhere — Finds the very first matching item, with an orElse fallback if no match is found.
4. sort — Reorders items in-place alphabetically or using custom criteria like string length.

Download main3.dart to run and experiment with these list methods in Flutter!

lessons.title: Set in Dart & Flutter | Unique Values, Union, Intersection & Difference
lessons.summary: Learn how Set in Dart automatically removes duplicate values and explore set operations like union, intersection, and difference.
lessons.body:
A Set in Dart is an unordered collection of unique items. Unlike a List, a Set will never contain duplicate values.

1. Automatic Duplicates Removal — Adding duplicate items into a Set does nothing.
2. Add & Remove — Work just like List methods using add() and remove().
3. contains() — Fast check to see if an item exists in the Set.
4. Set Operations — Perform union(), intersection(), and difference() between two sets effortlessly.

Download main4.dart to run and experiment with Dart Sets in Flutter!

lessons.title: Learn Map in Dart in 5 Minutes | Key-Value, JSON, Nested Data - Flutter Step by Step
lessons.summary: Master Map in Dart with key-value pairs, JSON parsing, adding/updating/removing entries, and nested data structures.
lessons.body:
A Map in Dart stores data as key-value pairs, similar to JSON objects.

1. Create & Access — Define Map<String, dynamic> and retrieve items by key using map['key'].
2. Add, Update & Remove — Modify entries effortlessly or remove unwanted keys with remove().
3. Keys, Values & Loop — Access .keys, .values, or iterate entries to build UI dynamically.
4. JSON Parsing — Decode JSON strings into Maps using jsonDecode() to handle API responses and nested data structures.

Download main5.dart to run and experiment with Dart Maps in Flutter!

lessons.title: Learn Functions in Dart in 7 Minutes | Define, Call, Parameters, Return - Flutter Step by Step
lessons.summary: Learn how to define, call, pass parameters, and return values with Dart functions to write clean, reusable Flutter code.
lessons.body:
Functions allow you to package reusable logic in Dart so you don't repeat the same code.

1. Define a Function — Specify the return type, function name, parameters, and function body.
2. Return Values — Use return to give back data (e.g. String greet(String name)).
3. void Functions — Use void when a function performs an action without returning a value (e.g. logWelcome()).
4. Parameters & Arguments — Pass variables into functions to make them dynamic and flexible.

Download main6.dart to run and experiment with Dart functions in Flutter!
